name: – Thomas Waitz – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on North Macedonia
part_text:
**What this report asks for**

This report does not change any law. It is the European Parliament's opinion on North Macedonia's progress towards joining the European Union. It says reform has stalled, especially on the courts and on fighting corruption. It asks North Macedonia's politicians to agree the constitutional changes needed to start the first round of membership talks. It also asks EU governments to keep their promises and to let citizens feel the benefits of closer ties before membership.

**Key points**

- The report only gives opinions and recommendations; it changes no laws.
- It affects North Macedonia's government, parties and citizens, plus EU governments.
- Next, EU governments decide when to move talks forward; no date is set.
